preconditions.name: ARM_INFL_LO::rv_live
preconditions.description: rv_final differs from precision_init by more than the floor (the Q-042/530c substrate-liveness contract). Worst cell reported.
preconditions.control: every seed of this arm; a dead rv makes the DV meaningless

preconditions.name: ARM_INFL_LO::f1_recalib_disabled_confirmed_fired
preconditions.description: recalib_cycles_fired must be 0 for every seed -- the WRITEBACK consumer (ree_core/sleep/phase_manager.py) writes mech204_recalibration_fired only when use_rem_precision_recalibration is True, so a nonzero count here means the ablation did not actually take effect (a config/wiring bug), not a scientific result.
preconditions.control: use_rem_precision_recalibration=False in every arm of this design

preconditions.name: ARM_INFL_LO::f1_recalib_disabled_confirmed_move
preconditions.description: recalib_mean_abs_move must be 0.0 for every seed -- same manipulation check as f1_recalib_disabled_confirmed_fired, on the movement statistic instead of the fired count.
preconditions.control: use_rem_precision_recalibration=False in every arm of this design

preconditions.name: ARM_INFL_LO::dose_levels_separated
preconditions.description: |rv_final(this arm) - rv_final(sibling arm at the OTHER asymmetry)|. THE 794 GATE, re-checked under F1-off: two nominally different doses producing the same rv is a SATURATION signature, not a null. Same statistic the DV routes on, against a control differing ONLY in the dose.
preconditions.control: sibling inflation arm at the other asymmetry level, same seeds -- differs only in the dose
